description.zh: 配平是调整系数，使每种原子在反应式两侧个数相等，并化成最简整数比；依据是反应中原子种类与总数不变。仅适用于本页的简单、理想、完全的反应。
description.en: Balancing adjusts coefficients so every element has equal counts on both sides, reduced to the simplest whole-number ratio, because atom kinds and totals do not change in a reaction. Valid for the simple, ideal, complete reactions on this page.

reason.zh: 原子守恒要求每个元素左右总数相等，配平就是把这条要求写成一组最小整数系数。
reason.en: Conservation of atoms demands equal totals per element on both sides; balancing writes that demand as a set of smallest whole-number coefficients.

title.zh: 怎样把一个化学方程式配平？
title.en: How do I balance a chemical equation?

ask.zh: 配平要让每种原子两边个数相等——为什么只能调系数，不能改化学式里的下标？
ask.en: Balancing must equalise every element's count on both sides — why may you only change coefficients, never the subscripts in a formula?

reveal.zh: 下标是物质本身的组成，改了就变成另一种物质；系数只改分子个数，不改物质种类，依据是反应中原子种类与总数不变。
reveal.en: Subscripts are part of a substance's identity — changing them makes a different substance; coefficients only change how many molecules react, which keeps every atom's kind and total unchanged.
